programme.title: Bizarre food: culinary trips / Skurrile Kost: Kulinarische Reisen
programme.desc: It doesn't always have to be bizarre and unusual, that is the motto of this `everything-eating spin-offs with Andrew Zimmer. Instead, this time he can be spoiled with culinary costings from the hottest cities in the world. / Es muss nicht immer skurril und ungewohnlich sein, das ist das Motto dieses `Alles-Esser-Spin-Offs mit Andrew Zimmern. Stattdessen lasst er sich diesmal mit kulinarischen Kostlichkeiten aus den angesagtesten Metropolen der Welt verwohnen.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to drive a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police service. From then on he is investigating with Commissioner Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - the quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel at Caroline Athanasiadis. programme.title: Q1 A note is wrong / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First the topic of the term searched is announced. With the help of four notes, the candidates should get on the right track - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel / SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: The Tyrolean Unterland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offers is the scene of the police team around criminal officer Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, which specializes in criminal psychology, who, with a lot of expertise and empathy, put the craft from the local criminals. The investigators are understood by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary inn "Pochlarner Stuben", and is blessed with a similar criminalistic sense of gaze. And finally there is Grafin Schonberg, who, with her contacts to the Kitzbuheler JetSet, proves again and again as valuable help for the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: Death in Paradise / Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. programme.title: Retribution / Retribution
programme.desc: The successful business man Matt lives with his family in Berlin. On the way to the school where he wants to unload his two children, he suddenly receives a call that tells him that a bomb was placed in his car that explodes if he stops the car. In order to save himself and his family, Matt has to follow a number of instructions that are becoming more and more dangerous and at the same time decrease the secret of the caller. / Der erfolgreiche Geschaftsmann Matt lebt mit seiner Familie in Berlin. Auf dem Weg zur Schule, an der er seine beiden Kinder abladen will, erhalt er plotzlich einen Anruf, der ihm verrat, dass in seinem Auto eine Bombe platziert wurde, die explodiert, sollte er das Auto anhalten. Um sich und seine Familie zu retten, muss Matt eine Reihe von Anweisungen befolgen, die immer gefahrlicher werden und gleichzeitig das Geheimnis des Anrufers entschlusseln.

The three are sent by Maja to an emotional road trip through Italy, in which the mid -thirties look at their past and tell of burst trauma, but also rethink their future. Finally, they realize that the best in life still comes. / Steffi, Lea und Toni werden von ihrer Freundin Maja auf ihre Hochzeit in Italien eingeladen. Dort angekommen, mussen sie feststellen, dass es keine Hochzeit geben wird, sondern das genaue Gegenteil. Die drei werden von Maja auf einen emotionalen Roadtrip durch Italien geschickt, bei dem die MittdreiSSigerinnen auf ihre Vergangenheit blicken und von geplatzten Traumen erzahlen, aber auch ihre Zukunft neu denken. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: LaLiga Talking Football / LaLiga Talking Football

programme.title: Ice Hockey - KHL / Ice Hockey - KHL
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other the best hockey world of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga svijeta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa.

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest rank of baseball league in North America. League beginners already before the end of the 19th century, in 1876. When the first season of the Netherlands' first season was played. In 1903. Today's structure was formed with the first edition of "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 matches. Out of a total of eight teams that select the Plejof two best play "World Series Final". The winner is the one who arrives first to four victories in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije

programme.title: Football: World Club Championship: quarterfinals: Real Madrid - Borussia Dortmund / Футбол: Световно клубно първенство: Четвъртфинал: Реал Мадрид - Борусия Дортмунд
programme.desc: BNT 1 will also broadcast the match between two of the best European teams Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund. The Spaniards were in the group with Al Hilal, with the two teams finished on an equal footing. Real then achieved two wins, and at the semifinals prevailed over the Italian Juventus 1-0. Borussia Dortmund also took 7 points in his group after two wins and one draw, and in the direct elimination phase beat Mexican Monterey by 2: 1. Madrid have 8 wins in the 16 games so far between the two teams, and Borussia will try to change statistics in New York. / БНТ 1 ще излъчи и двубоя между два от най-добрите европейски отбора Реал Мадрид и Борусия Дортмунд. Испанците бяха в група именно с Ал Хилал, като двата тима завършиха наравно. След това Реал постигна две победи, а на осминафиналите надделя над италианския Ювентус с 1:0. Борусия Дортмунд също взе 7 точки в групата си след две победи и едно равенство, а във фазата на директните елиминации надигра мексиканския Монтерей с 2:1. Мадридчани имат 8 победи в 16-те мача досега между двата отбора, а Борусия ще се опита да промени статистиката в Ню Йорк.

programme.title: Telepathian / Телепазарен прозорец
The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Land / Проект "Земя"
programme.desc: 1ep.: "Sun reflecting a space shield": The purpose of an experiment proposed by Professor Roger Angel is to deviate from Earth 2 % of the sun's rays in order to save humanity from fatal climate change. programme.title: Diary of the new / DNEVNIK NOVA
Marjorie Prime / Marjorie Prime
programme.desc: In the near future, 85-year-old Marjorie has the first symptoms of Alzheimer's disease. Her daughter Tess and son -in -law Jon hired a service called Prima that helps the patients with Alzheimer's disease by creating a hologram projection of deceased family members and thus feed on memories that patients lose. Marjorie chooses a hologram projection of her deceased husband Walter, but in the younger version. Walter Prime becomes curious and asks Jon to tell him as many details about Walter's life. Jon then begins to reveal family secrets that Marjorie should not find out ... / U skoroj budućnosti, 85-godišnja Marjorie ima prve simptome Alzheimerove bolesti. Njezina kći Tess i zet Jon angažiraju službu nazvanu Prime koja pomaže oboljelima od Alzheimerove bolesti tako što stvaraju hologramske projekcije preminulih članova obitelji i tako ih hrane sjećanjima koje bolesnici gube. Marjorie odabire hologramsku projekciju svog preminulog supruga Waltera, ali u mlađoj verziji. Walter Prime postaje znatiželjan i traži od Jona da mu ispriča što više detalja o Walterovom životu. Jon tada počinje otkrivati obiteljske tajne koje Marjorie ne bi smjela saznati...

programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Italy - Croatia, football / Italija - Hrvatska, Nogomet
programme.desc: Football: International Friendly Match - (Sport. Program) Through a long history of football football football, the national team always had a special charm with players and fans, whether it was official or friendly games. International friendly football matches are a great opportunity for menus and federations to take advantage of free representative terms without official teams to gather the teams and play different tactical ideas. In recent years, the practice has been playing such meetings on neutral ground so that fans from different sides of the world have the opportunity to see the best teams and individuals .... / Football: International Friendly Match - (sport. program) Kroz dugu povijest nogometa utakmice reprezentacija uvijek su imale posebnu draž kod igrača i navijača, bilo da se radilo o službenim ili prijateljskim utakmicama. Međunarodne prijateljske nogometne utakmice odlična su prilika izbornicima i savezima za iskoristiti slobodne reprezentativne termine bez službenih utakmica za okupljanje momčadi te uigravanje različitih taktičkih zamisli. Posljednjih godina praksa je odigravanje takvih susreta na neutralnom terenu kako bi navijači s različitih strana svijeta imali priliku pogledati najbolje momčadi i pojedince....

programme.title: Hrvace - Jarun, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 3rd round / Hrvace - Jarun, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 3. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Dinamo Predavac - Dinamo, SuperSport Croatian Football Cup 2025/2026. / Dinamo Predavac - Dinamo, SuperSport Hrvatski nogometni kup 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.title: Turkey - Croatia, Football, EP U21 qualifications / Turska - Hrvatska, Nogomet, Kvalifikacije za EP U21
programme.desc: UEFA European Under -21 Championship Qualification - (Sport. Program, 2025) U21 European Football Championship is a competition under the organization of UEFA and is held every two years. At the final of the main competition, the right of performing is achieved by 12 teams, hosts and the 11 best teams that successfully perform a qualifying cycle. A total of 54 teams enter the qualifying drum and are arranged in nine groups of six national teams. All teams in the group play each other's home meetings and away. Nine first -ranked national teams in each group achieve a direct placement on the finals, while the four best runner -up national teams over the Playoff Love in the last two places in the final of the European Championship ... / UEFA European Under-21 Championship Qualification - (sport. program, 2025) U21 Europsko nogometno prvenstvo natjecanje je pod organizacijom UEFE te se održava svake dvije godine. Na završnicu glavnog natjecanja pravo nastupa ostvaruje 12 momčadi, domaćin te 11 najboljih reprezentacija koje uspješno odrade kvalifikacijski ciklus. Ukupno 54 momčadi ulazi u bubanj kvalifikacija te su raspoređene u devet grupa po šest reprezentacija. Sve reprezentacije u skupini odigraju međusobne susrete doma i u gostima. Devet prvoplasiranih reprezentacija u svakoj grupi ostvaruju izravan plasman na završnicu dok četiri najbolje drugoplasirane reprezentacije preko playoffa love posljednja dva mjesta u završnici Europskog prvenstva...

programme.title: Motor vehicle - a German love / Kraftfahrzeug - Eine deutsche Liebe
programme.desc: The car is still fascinated almost 150 years after its history. The number of vehicles in Germany rose to a record high in 2024. The documentary filmmaker Jan Tenhaven meets passionate car lovers and sharp critics: Journalist Ulf Poschardt flashes from the sports car as part of the high culture, mobility expert Katja Diehl questions the status fetish, autodesigner Adrian van Hooydonk explains the aggressive front design, and VDA-Prasident Hildegard defends the car as "Ruckbat of the economy". Car manufacturers provide rare insights into their tricks of emotional proof of the emotional. Large pictures, shrill scenes and surprising insights condense into an entertaining road movie through the Autoland Germany. / Das Auto fasziniert fast 150 Jahre nach seiner Entstehungsgeschichte noch immer. programme.title: Suffering on four paws / Leiden auf vier Pfoten
programme.desc: Millions of pets in Germany suffer from agony: from shortness of breath and headache, for example because the brain does not fit into small breeding pads. Pain and suffering - only for the look. Dwarfspitz, pug, the French bulldog or Persian cats are a symbol of a trend that provides homage to health. Despite the agony paragraph in the Animal Welfare Act, which prohibits the breeding of sick vertebrates, more than 50 dog breeds, a dozen cat breeds as well as guinea pigs, rabbits or ornamental birds are affected in Germany. The ARD Story reveals violations at dog exhibitions and documents how breeds are issued and pretended despite the ban on exhibitions, which have the agony characteristics. A hidden SWR research shows that expensive dwarf spitz puppies are sold without examining the parents for hereditary diseases. Animal pathologist Prof. Achim Gruber: "We breeded many breeds." Is Germany ready to increase the law? / Millionen Haustiere in Deutschland leiden unter Qualzuchten: etwa unter Atemnot und Kopfschmerzen, weil das Hirn nicht in klein gezuchtete Schadel passt. Schmerzen und Leiden - nur fur das Aussehen. Zwergspitz, Mops, die franzosische Bulldogge oder Perserkatzen sind Symbol eines Trends, der Schonheit uber Gesundheit stellt. Trotz des Qualzuchtparagrafen im Tierschutzgesetz, der die Zucht von kranken Wirbeltieren verbietet, sind in Deutschland mehr als 50 Hunderassen, ein Dutzend Katzenrassen sowie Meerschweinchen, Kaninchen oder Ziervogel betroffen. Die ARD Story deckt VerstoSSe auf Hundeausstellungen auf und dokumentiert, wie trotz Ausstellungsverbots Rassen ausgestellt und pramiert werden, die Qualzuchtmerkmale aufweisen. Eine verdeckte SWR-Recherche zeigt, dass teure Zwergspitz-Welpen verkauft werden, ohne die Eltern auf Erbkrankheiten untersucht zu haben. Tierpathologe Prof. Achim Gruber: "Wir haben viele Rassen kaputt gezuchtet." Ist Deutschland bereit, das Gesetz zu verscharfen?

programme.title: Real life / Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: Unter Druck - Pastorin Anja und das Kirchenasyl
programme.desc: Churches have been offering a special shelter for more than 40 years: the church asylum. It is a privilege, not a (securitized) right. And his tolerance by the authority is increasingly questioned. Because, while society bitterly argues over a possible "turnaround in migration", the tolerance of the state disappears. This is also sprinted by the free church pastor Anja, who preserves church asylum in her community who threatens to deport a deportation. How does she master the difficult balancing act between night love and the state of law? The state of Bremen is considered a stronghold of the church asylum: 200 of the almost 2,400 cases nationwide were registered here in 2024. In the Advent season, of all people, the liberal Hanseatic city led to a scandal last year: the interior senator instructed its police to get a 25-year Somalier out of the church asylum and take it in custody in order to deport him to Finland. However, a human chain prevented the officials from entering the Bremen Zion community center. The consequence of the failed deportation: public controversy, unsettled communities, uncertained church superiors and tubular agents. What concretely means church asylum, the film uses the example of people who currently live in church asylum, as well as those who have used it in the past and are still closely connected to the community. In her work, Pastor Anja has to deal with agents. And there are also practical questions of everyday life, from food to language lessons. Because it means an enormous effort for a community to accommodate and look after people for over months. In 2013, every asylum seeker has the right to submit an urgent application to the administrative court against an deportation notice. Critics of the church asylum see the approach of the parishes as unnecessary. The migration researcher Stefan Luft speaks of "a certain way of being" from the university Bremen, he says that the churches have been massively intervene in the execution of the right to remedy and asylum. On the other hand, pastor Anja sees herself as a "mug-maker". This role understanding is particularly important to her in church asylum. Since 2017 she has been fleeing people to flee to Hartefall, who rely on the church asylum as the last hope. But their work increasingly got between the fronts. It belongs to your Christian conviction that it should be heard on a case -by -case basis why a person is looking for the help of your community in need. At the same time, she is criticized by outdoors that she is overriding state action in migration policy. Can church do an integration work that the state does not create? Or do pastors use a privilege here contrary to the will of society? / Seit mehr als 40 Jahren bieten Kirchen Gefluchteten einen besonderen Schutzraum: das Kirchenasyl. Es ist ein Privileg, kein (verbrieftes) Recht. Und seine Duldung durch die Behorden wird zunehmend infrage gestellt. Denn, wahrend die Gesellschaft erbittert uber eine mogliche "Migrationswende" streitet, schwindet die Toleranz des Staates. Das spurt auch die freikirchliche Pastorin Anja, die in ihrer Gemeinde Schutzsuchenden, denen eine Abschiebung droht, Kirchenasyl gewahrt. Wie meistert sie den schwierigen Balanceakt zwischen Nachstenliebe und Gesetzestreue?Das Land Bremen gilt als Hochburg des Kirchenasyls: 200 der insgesamt knapp 2.400 Falle bundesweit wurden 2024 hier registriert. Ausgerechnet in der Adventszeit kam es in der liberalen Hansestadt letztes Jahr zum Eklat: Der Innensenator wies seine Polizei an, einen 25-jahrigen Somalier aus dem Kirchenasyl zu holen und in Gewahrsam zu nehmen, um ihn nach Finnland abschieben zu konnen. Eine Menschenkette hinderte die Beamten jedoch daran, das Bremer Zion-Gemeindezentrum zu betreten. Die Folge der gescheiterten Abschiebung: offentliche Kontroversen, verunsicherte Gemeinden, verschnupfte Kirchenobere und verargerte Behorden.Was Kirchenasyl konkret bedeutet, zeigt der Film am Beispiel von Menschen, die aktuell im Kirchenasyl leben, sowie von denen, die es in der Vergangenheit in Anspruch genommen haben und der Gemeinde bis heute eng verbunden sind. In ihrer Arbeit muss sich Pastorin Anja mit Behorden auseinandersetzen. Und es stellen sich auch praktische Fragen des alltaglichen Lebens, vom Essen bis zum Sprachunterricht. Denn es bedeutet einen enormen Aufwand fur eine Gemeinde, Menschen uber Monate unterzubringen, zu ernahren und zu betreuen.Seit 2013 hat jeder Asylsuchende das Recht, gegen einen Abschiebungsbescheid einen Eilantrag beim Verwaltungsgericht zu stellen. Kritiker des Kirchenasyls sehen das Vorgehen der Kirchengemeinden daher als unnotig an. Von "einer gewissen AnmaSSung" spricht der Migrationsforscher Stefan Luft von der Universitat Bremen, er sagt, die Kirchen wurden in den Vollzug des Auslander- und Asylrechts massiv eingreifen.Pastorin Anja sieht sich dagegen als "Moglichmacherin". Dieses Rollenverstandnis ist ihr beim Kirchenasyl besonders wichtig. Seit 2017 kummert sie sich um Menschen auf der Flucht, um Hartefalle, die auf das Kirchenasyl als letzte Hoffnung setzen. Doch zunehmend gerat ihre Arbeit zwischen die Fronten. Es gehort zu ihrer christlichen Überzeugung, von Fall zu Fall sich anzuhoren, warum ein Mensch in Not die Hilfe ihrer Gemeinde sucht. Gleichzeitig wird sie immer scharfer von AuSSenstehenden kritisiert, dass sie sich uber das staatliche Handeln in der Migrationspolitik hinwegsetzt.Kann Kirche eine Integrationsarbeit leisten, die der Staat nicht schafft? Oder nutzen Pastorinnen und Pastoren hier ein Privileg entgegen dem Willen der Gesellschaft?

programme.title: Detours of the heart / Umwege des Herzens
programme.desc: "Typical: wages me from her life, and if she needs me, she calls": The successful Frankfurt architect Sarah von Wythersheim (Sonja Kirchberger) has not seen her sister Susanne (Jenny Schily), who lives with her husband Max (Jochen Nickel) and the three children on a farm in Vogelsberg, since eighteen years. She ignores an urgent news of the family that Susanne reaches shortly before her departure on vacation. During the holidays, she and her livelihood Tobias (Martin Umbach) learn that Susanne had suffered liver damage in an accident and needed her sister as an organ donor. Susanne's eighteen -year -old son Boris (Frederic Welter) has stood for a tissue transplant, but the mother dies shortly after the operation. And Sarah returns to Germany with the feel of being to blame for her sister's death. To offer your brother -in -law help, you drive into the Vogelsberg and find the family in a desolate state. Although they urgently needed their support, Max and the slowly recent Boris only want Sarah to disappear again because they consider them a selfish, super -flat career woman. But after weeks of struggle for the trust of the family, Sarah seems to be successful. She suddenly faces the question of what the more early life in the Frankfurt Schickeria means at all. And she has to get her relationship with Max Klaren, who was at the beginning of the beserved development: the two had fallen in love during Susanne's first pregnancy during each other. / "Typisch: Tilgt mich aus ihrem Leben, und wenn sie mich braucht, ruft sie an": Die erfolgreiche Frankfurter Architektin Sarah von Wythersheim (Sonja Kirchberger) hat ihre Schwester Susanne (Jenny Schily), die mit ihrem Mann Max (Jochen Nickel) und den drei Kindern auf einem Bauernhof im Vogelsberg lebt, seit achtzehn Jahren nicht gesehen. Eine dringende Nachricht der Familie, die Susanne kurz vor ihrem Aufbruch in den Urlaub erreicht, ignoriert sie. Noch in den Ferien erfahren sie und ihr Lebensgefahrte Tobias (Martin Umbach), dass Susanne bei einem Unfall einen Leberschaden davongetragen hat und ihre Schwester als Organspenderin gebraucht hatte. Zwar hat Susannes achtzehnjahriger Sohn Boris (Frederic Welter) sich fur eine Gewebeverpflanzung zur Verfugung gestellt, doch die Mutter stirbt kurz nach der Operation. Und Sarah kehrt mit dem Gefuhl nach Deutschland zuruck, am Tod ihrer Schwester schuld zu sein. Um ihrem Schwager Hilfe anzubieten, fahrt sie in den Vogelsberg und findet die Familie in einem desolaten Zustand vor. Obwohl sie ihre Unterstutzung dringend notig hatten, wollen Max und der langsam genesende Boris eigentlich nur, dass Sarah wieder verschwindet, weil sie sie fur eine egoistische, oberflachliche Karrierefrau halten. Aber nach Wochen zahen Ringens um das Vertrauen der Familie scheint Sarah Erfolg zu haben. Sie steht plotzlich vor der Frage, was das fruhere Leben in der Frankfurter Schickeria ihr uberhaupt bedeutet. Und sie muss ihre Beziehung zu Max klaren, die am Anfang der verhangnisvollen Entwicklung stand: Die beiden hatten sich wahrend Susannes erster Schwangerschaft ineinander verliebt.

Denn es bedeutet einen enormen Aufwand fur eine Gemeinde, Menschen uber Monate unterzubringen, zu ernahren und zu betreuen.Seit 2013 hat jeder Asylsuchende das Recht, gegen einen Abschiebungsbescheid einen Eilantrag beim Verwaltungsgericht zu stellen. Kritiker des Kirchenasyls sehen das Vorgehen der Kirchengemeinden daher als unnotig an. Von "einer gewissen AnmaSSung" spricht der Migrationsforscher Stefan Luft von der Universitat Bremen, er sagt, die Kirchen wurden in den Vollzug des Auslander- und Asylrechts massiv eingreifen.Pastorin Anja sieht sich dagegen als "Moglichmacherin". Dieses Rollenverstandnis ist ihr beim Kirchenasyl besonders wichtig. Seit 2017 kummert sie sich um Menschen auf der Flucht, um Hartefalle, die auf das Kirchenasyl als letzte Hoffnung setzen. Doch zunehmend gerat ihre Arbeit zwischen die Fronten. Es gehort zu ihrer christlichen Überzeugung, von Fall zu Fall sich anzuhoren, warum ein Mensch in Not die Hilfe ihrer Gemeinde sucht. Gleichzeitig wird sie immer scharfer von AuSSenstehenden kritisiert, dass sie sich uber das staatliche Handeln in der Migrationspolitik hinwegsetzt.Kann Kirche eine Integrationsarbeit leisten, die der Staat nicht schafft? Oder nutzen Pastorinnen und Pastoren hier ein Privileg entgegen dem Willen der Gesellschaft?

programme.desc: Headache, unrest, nervousness, aggression and phantom bells: the withdrawal symptoms among the young people are violent. programme.desc: The Danube Island is located in the middle of Vienna - a green oasis in the heart of the city. For many Viennese, she is a small paradise right in front of the home, especially for those who cannot afford a second home or vacation by the sea. In the summer months, streams into the local recreation area every day. Whether immigrants or long -established, young or old, sporty or sociable - everyone comes together on the Danube Island. But where many people meet, there are no conflicts: Questions about space, mull and lamp regularly ensure tensions. How much space does the Danube Island offer for this diversity? Where does cohesion arise - and where friction? Adriana Juric has searched for answers and visited various communities on the island - all with their own ways of life and needs. The Danube Island is changing: Gastronomers over less customers complain about less and more popular since the 2000s. The nudist community also shrinks increasingly, and visitors complain about grill zones that are mainly used by migrant families, others store themselves on cyclists or feel the atmosphere as unsafe. Nobody liked to do without their own place on the island. / Mitten in Wien liegt die Donauinsel - eine grune Oase im Herzen der Stadt. Fur viele Wienerinnen und Wiener ist sie ein kleines Paradies direkt vor der Haustur, besonders fur jene, die sich weder einen Zweitwohnsitz am Land noch Urlaub am Meer leisten konnen. In den Sommermonaten stromen taglich Tausende ins Naherholungsgebiet. Ob Zugewanderte oder Alteingesessene, jung oder alt, sportlich oder gesellig - auf der Donauinsel kommen alle zusammen. programme.title: While 1 / Dok 1
programme.desc: Headache, unrest, nervousness, aggression and phantom bells: the withdrawal symptoms among the young people are violent. The missing cell phone is to blame. 69 young people for Dok 1 An experiment and forego their mobile device for three weeks. Means: no social media, no news, no communication. Above all, the beginning is hard, because young people spend an average of about five hours a day with their cell phone and belong to a generation that often does not know what it is like to live without a smartphone. After four to five days, the young people discover the positive sides of the withdrawal. The extraordinary experiment is scientifically accompanied by the Anton-Proksch Institute and the Sigmund-Freud private university in Vienna. A DOK 1 that looks deep into the world of real and thought of the 16-year schoolchildren and shows how dependent we are all about our smartphones. The hip-hop superstar Raf Camora, who grew up in Vienna, also knows this dependence. After an obese, he prescribed an eight-month social media break. He makes an exception for DOK 1 and describes in one of his extraordinary interviews how his life has improved. / Kopfschmerzen, Unruhe, Nervositat, Aggressionen und Phantomklingeln: Die Entzugserscheinungen bei den Jugendlichen sind heftig. Schuld daran ist das fehlende Handy. 69 Jugendliche wagen fur Dok 1 ein Experiment und verzichten drei Wochen auf ihr Mobilgerat. Nach vier bis funf Tagen entdecken die Jugendlichen die positiven Seiten des Entzugs. Eine Initiative will das andern und die alte Obstbaumsorte wieder bekannter machen - etwa durch spannende Spedling-Rezepte.Urlaub in den BaumkronenMit dem Ruf der Kauzchen inmitten der Baumkronen einschlafen - das Baumhaus Buchengrun in Dobl-Zwaring in der Steiermark ist ein etwas anderer Urlaubsbauernhof. programme.title: The Pantanal - Brazil's mysterious water world / Das Pantanal - Brasiliens geheimnisvolle Wasserwelt
programme.desc: The largest inland moisture area is located in the sudwest of Brazil: the Pantanal. Almost half a year, thanks to the productive rainy season, thousands of square kilometers are under water. The change between floods and dry phases created a dense mosaic of lakes and small river walking, forest and grass landscapes over millions of years. Many, partly rare animal and plant species find a last refuge in the middle of habitats in the unique lowlands, which have been affected by deforestation, cattle breeding and agriculture. Here, Jaguars and Pumas are feasted on the lurk, while Capybaras and swamp deer feast in the aquatic sea. In between, rival Kaimane with giant more fountains rival the best fishmen. Himmel Blue Hyazinth Aras, the greatest parrots in the world, loudly the dense treetops, under which belt animals dig deep earth buildings and ants send their long tongue to termite hunting. However, the long -term paradise has an Achilles' heel: it depends on the rain, which is constantly less ... Processing: Doris Hochmayr / Im Sudwesten Brasiliens liegt das groSSte Binnenland-Feuchtgebiet der Erde: das Pantanal. Fast ein halbes Jahr stehen hier dank der ergiebigen Regenzeit tausende Quadratkilometer Land unter Wasser. Der Wechsel zwischen Überschwemmungen und Trockenphasen schuf uber Jahrmillionen ein dichtes Mosaik aus Seen und kleinen Flusslaufen, Waldern und Graslandschaften. Viele, teils seltene Tier- und Pflanzenarten finden in der einzigartigen Tiefebene ein letztes Refugium inmitten von Lebensraumen, die durch Abholzung, Viehzucht und Ackerbau stark in Mitleidenschaft gezogen sind. Hier liegen Jaguare und Pumas auf der Lauer, wahrend Capybaras und Sumpfhirsche im Wasserpflanzenmeer schlemmen. Dazwischen rivalisieren Kaimane mit Riesenottern um die besten Fischgrunde. Himmelblaue Hyazinth-Aras, die groSSten Papageien der Welt, bevolkern lautstark die dichten Baumkronen, unter denen Gurteltiere tiefe Erdbauten graben und Ameisenbaren ihre lange Zunge auf Termitenjagd schicken. Das weitlaufige Paradies hat jedoch eine Achillesferse: es hangt vom Regen ab, der stetig weniger wird…Bearbeitung: Doris Hochmayr

programme.title: We, the youth of Iran / Wir, die Jugend des Iran
programme.desc: With the violent death of student Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody, three years ago, the greatest wave of protest in Iran since the state base in 1979. Nationwide, young people have been on the road nationwide, opposed the authority of the Mullah regime and demanded their freedom. The protests were bloodily depressed, but the change in Iranian youth continues unstoppably. Based on the stories of six young women, the world journal shows an extraordinary insight into the young, educated social class of Iran. 60% of the population is under 35 years. Their life is characterized by state repression and Willkur, of economic crisis and unemployment, but many are politicized, feminist, grun and networked. "It is the country that has to arise, not me," says a young student - and speaks from the heart of many people in Iran. Design: Solène Chalvon -Fioriti / Mit dem gewaltsamen Tod der Studentin Jina Mahsa Amini in Polizeigewahrsam begann vor drei Jahren die groSSte Protestwelle im Iran seit der Staatsgrundung 1979. Landesweit gingen junge Menschen auf die StraSSe, widersetzten sich der Autoritat des Mullah-Regimes und forderten ihre Freiheit ein. Die Proteste wurden blutig niedergeschlagen, doch die Wandlung der iranischen Jugend geht unaufhaltsam weiter.Das WELTjournal zeigt anhand der Geschichten von sechs jungen Frauen einen auSSergewohnlichen Einblick in die junge, gebildete Gesellschaftsschicht des Iran. 60% der Bevolkerung sind unter 35 Jahre. Ihr Leben ist gepragt von staatlicher Repression und Willkur, von Wirtschaftskrise und Arbeitslosigkeit, doch viele sind politisiert, feministisch, grun und vernetzt. "Es ist das Land, das sich verandern muss, nicht ich", sagt eine junge Studentin - und spricht damit vielen Menschen im Iran aus dem Herzen.Gestaltung: Solène Chalvon-Fioriti

programme.title: Iran's water crisis - mismanagement, corruption and climate change / Irans Wasserkrise - Misswirtschaft, Korruption und Klimawandel
programme.desc: Heat, durre and years of mismanagement have brought the Iranian capital Tehran to the edge of a water emergency. Stream and water shutdowns let facts stand still and millions of people without tap water or air conditioning. Finally, a temporary closure of the capital or its long-term relocation was discussed. In the World Journal +, the award-winning Canadian-Iranian documentary filmmaker Gelareh Darabi is followed by the path of the water crisis. Inefficient water management in agriculture, into which 90% of the drinking water flows, and wild growth on Staudammen and fountain have massively strengthened the consequences of climate change in recent decades. 80% of the reservoirs have dried up. The Zayandeh Rud, the once water-rich river of the central Iran, is also dry. Lake Urmia, once one of the largest salt lakes on earth, has shrunk to a tenth of its flat. Meanwhile, the bizarre aesthetics of the dried water attracts photographers. If Iran continues as before, the half of its provinces will be uninhabitable within the next decades. Design: Gelareh Darabi / Hitze, Durre und jahrelanges Missmanagement haben die iranische Hauptstadt Teheran an den Rand eines Wassernotstands gebracht.Strom- und Wasserabschaltungen lassen Fabriken stillstehen und Millionen Menschen ohne Leitungswasser oder Klimaanlage zuruck. Zuletzt wurde sogar eine zeitweilige SchlieSSung der Hauptstadt oder deren langfristige Verlegung diskutiert.Im WELTjournal + verfolgt die preisgekronte kanadisch-iranische Dokumentarfilmerin Gelareh Darabi den Weg der Wasserkrise zuruck an die Anfange. Ineffizientes Wassermanagement in der Landwirtschaft, in die 90% des Trinkwassers flieSSen, und ein Wildwuchs an Staudammen und Brunnen haben in den letzten Jahrzehnten die Folgen des Klimawandels massiv verstarkt. 80% der Stauseen sind ausgetrocknet. Der Zayandeh Rud, der einst wasserreichste Fluss des Zentral-Iran, ist den GroSSteil des Jahres ebenfalls trocken. Der Urmia-See, einst einer der groSSten Salzseen der Erde, ist auf ein Zehntel seiner Flache geschrumpft. Die bizarre Ästhetik der ausgetrockneten Gewasser lockt unterdessen Fotografen an. Macht der Iran weiter wie bisher, wird innerhalb der nachsten Jahrzehnte knapp die Halfte seiner Provinzen unbewohnbar sein.Gestaltung: Gelareh Darabi

programme.title: The Lisbon thriller / Der Lissabon-Krimi
programme.desc: Captivating case on the hot pavement of Portugal's pulsating metropolis! With his wife, Witwer Eduardo Silva (Jurgen Tarrach) also lost his daughter Ines (Helen Woigk). The young woman has been going to him since the mother's death. But when I need the father's assistant, Eduardo is naturally immediately on hand. The death of his wife has destroyed the family life of lawyer Eduardo Silva. Since then, his daughter Ines has been sporadically. When she reappears, she needs an alibi. Her friend, the ecotrorist Miguel Alcántara, is suspected of murder. In order to get to him, the public prosecutor's office is under pressure on Ines. In the hope of reducing the gap between them, Eduardo is attached to his daughter. A case that leads the fine -shaped lawyer to his stress limits. / Fesselnder Fall auf dem heiSSen Pflaster von Portugals pulsierender Metropole! Mit seiner Frau hat Witwer Eduardo Silva (Jurgen Tarrach) einst auch seine Tochter Ines (Helen Woigk) verloren. Die junge Frau geht seit dem Tod der Mutter auf Distanz zu ihm. Doch als Ines vaterlichen Beistand braucht, ist Eduardo naturlich sofort zur Stelle.Der Tod seiner Frau hat das Familienleben von Rechtsanwalt Eduardo Silva zerstort. Nur sporadisch schaut seine Tochter Ines seither bei ihm vorbei. Als sie wieder einmal auftaucht, braucht sie ein Alibi. Ihr Freund, der Ökoterrorist Miguel Alcántara, steht unter Mordverdacht. Um an ihn heranzukommen, ubt die Staatsanwaltschaft Druck auf Ines aus. In der Hoffnung, die Kluft zwischen ihnen zu verringern, steht Eduardo seiner Tochter bei. programme.title: We, the youth of Iran / Wir, die Jugend des Iran
programme.desc: With the violent death of student Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody, three years ago, the greatest wave of protest in Iran since the state base in 1979. Nationwide, young people have been on the road nationwide, opposed the authority of the Mullah regime and demanded their freedom. The protests were bloodily depressed, but the change in Iranian youth continues unstoppably. Based on the stories of six young women, the world journal shows an extraordinary insight into the young, educated social class of Iran. 60% of the population is under 35 years. Their life is characterized by state repression and Willkur, of economic crisis and unemployment, but many are politicized, feminist, grun and networked. "It is the country that has to arise, not me," says a young student - and speaks from the heart of many people in Iran. Design: Solène Chalvon -Fioriti / Mit dem gewaltsamen Tod der Studentin Jina Mahsa Amini in Polizeigewahrsam begann vor drei Jahren die groSSte Protestwelle im Iran seit der Staatsgrundung 1979. Landesweit gingen junge Menschen auf die StraSSe, widersetzten sich der Autoritat des Mullah-Regimes und forderten ihre Freiheit ein. Die Proteste wurden blutig niedergeschlagen, doch die Wandlung der iranischen Jugend geht unaufhaltsam weiter.Das WELTjournal zeigt anhand der Geschichten von sechs jungen Frauen einen auSSergewohnlichen Einblick in die junge, gebildete Gesellschaftsschicht des Iran. 60% der Bevolkerung sind unter 35 Jahre. Ihr Leben ist gepragt von staatlicher Repression und Willkur, von Wirtschaftskrise und Arbeitslosigkeit, doch viele sind politisiert, feministisch, grun und vernetzt. "Es ist das Land, das sich verandern muss, nicht ich", sagt eine junge Studentin - und spricht damit vielen Menschen im Iran aus dem Herzen.Gestaltung: Solène Chalvon-Fioriti

programme.title: Iran's water crisis - mismanagement, corruption and climate change / Irans Wasserkrise - Misswirtschaft, Korruption und Klimawandel
programme.desc: Heat, durre and years of mismanagement have brought the Iranian capital Tehran to the edge of a water emergency. Stream and water shutdowns let facts stand still and millions of people without tap water or air conditioning. Finally, a temporary closure of the capital or its long-term relocation was discussed. In the World Journal +, the award-winning Canadian-Iranian documentary filmmaker Gelareh Darabi is followed by the path of the water crisis. Inefficient water management in agriculture, into which 90% of the drinking water flows, and wild growth on Staudammen and fountain have massively strengthened the consequences of climate change in recent decades. 80% of the reservoirs have dried up. The Zayandeh Rud, the once water-rich river of the central Iran, is also dry. Lake Urmia, once one of the largest salt lakes on earth, has shrunk to a tenth of its flat. Meanwhile, the bizarre aesthetics of the dried water attracts photographers. If Iran continues as before, the half of its provinces will be uninhabitable within the next decades. Design: Gelareh Darabi / Hitze, Durre und jahrelanges Missmanagement haben die iranische Hauptstadt Teheran an den Rand eines Wassernotstands gebracht.Strom- und Wasserabschaltungen lassen Fabriken stillstehen und Millionen Menschen ohne Leitungswasser oder Klimaanlage zuruck. Zuletzt wurde sogar eine zeitweilige SchlieSSung der Hauptstadt oder deren langfristige Verlegung diskutiert.Im WELTjournal + verfolgt die preisgekronte kanadisch-iranische Dokumentarfilmerin Gelareh Darabi den Weg der Wasserkrise zuruck an die Anfange. Ineffizientes Wassermanagement in der Landwirtschaft, in die 90% des Trinkwassers flieSSen, und ein Wildwuchs an Staudammen und Brunnen haben in den letzten Jahrzehnten die Folgen des Klimawandels massiv verstarkt. 80% der Stauseen sind ausgetrocknet. Der Zayandeh Rud, der einst wasserreichste Fluss des Zentral-Iran, ist den GroSSteil des Jahres ebenfalls trocken. Der Urmia-See, einst einer der groSSten Salzseen der Erde, ist auf ein Zehntel seiner Flache geschrumpft. Die bizarre Ästhetik der ausgetrockneten Gewasser lockt unterdessen Fotografen an. Macht der Iran weiter wie bisher, wird innerhalb der nachsten Jahrzehnte knapp die Halfte seiner Provinzen unbewohnbar sein.Gestaltung: Gelareh Darabi

programme.title: Report / Report
The Pantanal - Brazil's mysterious water world / Das Pantanal - Brasiliens geheimnisvolle Wasserwelt
programme.desc: The largest inland moisture area is located in the sudwest of Brazil: the Pantanal. Almost half a year, thanks to the productive rainy season, thousands of square kilometers are under water. The change between floods and dry phases created a dense mosaic of lakes and small river walking, forest and grass landscapes over millions of years. Many, partly rare animal and plant species find a last refuge in the middle of habitats in the unique lowlands, which have been affected by deforestation, cattle breeding and agriculture. Here, Jaguars and Pumas are feasted on the lurk, while Capybaras and swamp deer feast in the aquatic sea. In between, rival Kaimane with giant more fountains rival the best fishmen. Himmel Blue Hyazinth Aras, the greatest parrots in the world, loudly the dense treetops, under which belt animals dig deep earth buildings and ants send their long tongue to termite hunting. However, the long -term paradise has an Achilles' heel: it depends on the rain, which is constantly less ... Processing: Doris Hochmayr / Im Sudwesten Brasiliens liegt das groSSte Binnenland-Feuchtgebiet der Erde: das Pantanal. Fast ein halbes Jahr stehen hier dank der ergiebigen Regenzeit tausende Quadratkilometer Land unter Wasser. Der Wechsel zwischen Überschwemmungen und Trockenphasen schuf uber Jahrmillionen ein dichtes Mosaik aus Seen und kleinen Flusslaufen, Waldern und Graslandschaften. Viele, teils seltene Tier- und Pflanzenarten finden in der einzigartigen Tiefebene ein letztes Refugium inmitten von Lebensraumen, die durch Abholzung, Viehzucht und Ackerbau stark in Mitleidenschaft gezogen sind. Hier liegen Jaguare und Pumas auf der Lauer, wahrend Capybaras und Sumpfhirsche im Wasserpflanzenmeer schlemmen. Dazwischen rivalisieren Kaimane mit Riesenottern um die besten Fischgrunde. Himmelblaue Hyazinth-Aras, die groSSten Papageien der Welt, bevolkern lautstark die dichten Baumkronen, unter denen Gurteltiere tiefe Erdbauten graben und Ameisenbaren ihre lange Zunge auf Termitenjagd schicken. Das weitlaufige Paradies hat jedoch eine Achillesferse: es hangt vom Regen ab, der stetig weniger wird…Bearbeitung: Doris Hochmayr

programme.title: Land and people / Land und Leute
programme.desc: Earth rent for the paving of storage, carrots, cabbage, potatoes - summer and Fruhherbst bring a rich mouse harvest. In order to store everything well into autumn and winter, many farmers' courtyard and older Hauser still have earth cellars. Here the gem has optimal conditions. In modern new buildings, however, this is rarely found, but with very simple means you can use the centuries -old tradition of storage in the earth: with an ground rent. programme.title: The Pantanal - Brazil's mysterious water world / Das Pantanal - Brasiliens geheimnisvolle Wasserwelt
programme.desc: The largest inland moisture area is located in the sudwest of Brazil: the Pantanal. Almost half a year, thanks to the productive rainy season, thousands of square kilometers are under water. The change between floods and dry phases created a dense mosaic of lakes and small river walking, forest and grass landscapes over millions of years. Many, partly rare animal and plant species find a last refuge in the middle of habitats in the unique lowlands, which have been affected by deforestation, cattle breeding and agriculture. Here, Jaguars and Pumas are feasted on the lurk, while Capybaras and swamp deer feast in the aquatic sea. In between, rival Kaimane with giant more fountains rival the best fishmen. Himmel Blue Hyazinth Aras, the greatest parrots in the world, loudly the dense treetops, under which belt animals dig deep earth buildings and ants send their long tongue to termite hunting. However, the long -term paradise has an Achilles' heel: it depends on the rain, which is constantly less ... Processing: Doris Hochmayr / Im Sudwesten Brasiliens liegt das groSSte Binnenland-Feuchtgebiet der Erde: das Pantanal. Fast ein halbes Jahr stehen hier dank der ergiebigen Regenzeit tausende Quadratkilometer Land unter Wasser. Der Wechsel zwischen Überschwemmungen und Trockenphasen schuf uber Jahrmillionen ein dichtes Mosaik aus Seen und kleinen Flusslaufen, Waldern und Graslandschaften. Viele, teils seltene Tier- und Pflanzenarten finden in der einzigartigen Tiefebene ein letztes Refugium inmitten von Lebensraumen, die durch Abholzung, Viehzucht und Ackerbau stark in Mitleidenschaft gezogen sind. Hier liegen Jaguare und Pumas auf der Lauer, wahrend Capybaras und Sumpfhirsche im Wasserpflanzenmeer schlemmen. Dazwischen rivalisieren Kaimane mit Riesenottern um die besten Fischgrunde. Himmelblaue Hyazinth-Aras, die groSSten Papageien der Welt, bevolkern lautstark die dichten Baumkronen, unter denen Gurteltiere tiefe Erdbauten graben und Ameisenbaren ihre lange Zunge auf Termitenjagd schicken. programme.title: We, the youth of Iran / Wir, die Jugend des Iran
programme.desc: With the violent death of student Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody, three years ago, the greatest wave of protest in Iran since the state base in 1979. Nationwide, young people have been on the road nationwide, opposed the authority of the Mullah regime and demanded their freedom. The protests were bloodily depressed, but the change in Iranian youth continues unstoppably. Based on the stories of six young women, the world journal shows an extraordinary insight into the young, educated social class of Iran. 60% of the population is under 35 years. Their life is characterized by state repression and Willkur, of economic crisis and unemployment, but many are politicized, feminist, grun and networked. "It is the country that has to arise, not me," says a young student - and speaks from the heart of many people in Iran. Design: Solène Chalvon -Fioriti / Mit dem gewaltsamen Tod der Studentin Jina Mahsa Amini in Polizeigewahrsam begann vor drei Jahren die groSSte Protestwelle im Iran seit der Staatsgrundung 1979. Landesweit gingen junge Menschen auf die StraSSe, widersetzten sich der Autoritat des Mullah-Regimes und forderten ihre Freiheit ein. Die Proteste wurden blutig niedergeschlagen, doch die Wandlung der iranischen Jugend geht unaufhaltsam weiter.Das WELTjournal zeigt anhand der Geschichten von sechs jungen Frauen einen auSSergewohnlichen Einblick in die junge, gebildete Gesellschaftsschicht des Iran. 60% der Bevolkerung sind unter 35 Jahre. Ihr Leben ist gepragt von staatlicher Repression und Willkur, von Wirtschaftskrise und Arbeitslosigkeit, doch viele sind politisiert, feministisch, grun und vernetzt. programme.title: Iran's water crisis - mismanagement, corruption and climate change / Irans Wasserkrise - Misswirtschaft, Korruption und Klimawandel
programme.desc: Heat, durre and years of mismanagement have brought the Iranian capital Tehran to the edge of a water emergency. Stream and water shutdowns let facts stand still and millions of people without tap water or air conditioning. Finally, a temporary closure of the capital or its long-term relocation was discussed. In the World Journal +, the award-winning Canadian-Iranian documentary filmmaker Gelareh Darabi is followed by the path of the water crisis. Inefficient water management in agriculture, into which 90% of the drinking water flows, and wild growth on Staudammen and fountain have massively strengthened the consequences of climate change in recent decades. 80% of the reservoirs have dried up. The Zayandeh Rud, the once water-rich river of the central Iran, is also dry. Lake Urmia, once one of the largest salt lakes on earth, has shrunk to a tenth of its flat. Meanwhile, the bizarre aesthetics of the dried water attracts photographers. If Iran continues as before, the half of its provinces will be uninhabitable within the next decades. Design: Gelareh Darabi / Hitze, Durre und jahrelanges Missmanagement haben die iranische Hauptstadt Teheran an den Rand eines Wassernotstands gebracht.Strom- und Wasserabschaltungen lassen Fabriken stillstehen und Millionen Menschen ohne Leitungswasser oder Klimaanlage zuruck. Zuletzt wurde sogar eine zeitweilige SchlieSSung der Hauptstadt oder deren langfristige Verlegung diskutiert.Im WELTjournal + verfolgt die preisgekronte kanadisch-iranische Dokumentarfilmerin Gelareh Darabi den Weg der Wasserkrise zuruck an die Anfange. Ineffizientes Wassermanagement in der Landwirtschaft, in die 90% des Trinkwassers flieSSen, und ein Wildwuchs an Staudammen und Brunnen haben in den letzten Jahrzehnten die Folgen des Klimawandels massiv verstarkt. 80% der Stauseen sind ausgetrocknet. Der Zayandeh Rud, der einst wasserreichste Fluss des Zentral-Iran, ist den GroSSteil des Jahres ebenfalls trocken. Der Urmia-See, einst einer der groSSten Salzseen der Erde, ist auf ein Zehntel seiner Flache geschrumpft. Die bizarre Ästhetik der ausgetrockneten Gewasser lockt unterdessen Fotografen an. Macht der Iran weiter wie bisher, wird innerhalb der nachsten Jahrzehnte knapp die Halfte seiner Provinzen unbewohnbar sein.Gestaltung: Gelareh Darabi

programme.title: Iran's water crisis - mismanagement, corruption and climate change / Irans Wasserkrise - Misswirtschaft, Korruption und Klimawandel
programme.desc: Heat, durre and years of mismanagement have brought the Iranian capital Tehran to the edge of a water emergency. Stream and water shutdowns let facts stand still and millions of people without tap water or air conditioning. Finally, a temporary closure of the capital or its long-term relocation was discussed. In the World Journal +, the award-winning Canadian-Iranian documentary filmmaker Gelareh Darabi is followed by the path of the water crisis. Inefficient water management in agriculture, into which 90% of the drinking water flows, and wild growth on Staudammen and fountain have massively strengthened the consequences of climate change in recent decades. 80% of the reservoirs have dried up. The Zayandeh Rud, the once water-rich river of the central Iran, is also dry. Lake Urmia, once one of the largest salt lakes on earth, has shrunk to a tenth of its flat. Meanwhile, the bizarre aesthetics of the dried water attracts photographers. If Iran continues as before, the half of its provinces will be uninhabitable within the next decades. Design: Gelareh Darabi / Hitze, Durre und jahrelanges Missmanagement haben die iranische Hauptstadt Teheran an den Rand eines Wassernotstands gebracht.Strom- und Wasserabschaltungen lassen Fabriken stillstehen und Millionen Menschen ohne Leitungswasser oder Klimaanlage zuruck. Zuletzt wurde sogar eine zeitweilige SchlieSSung der Hauptstadt oder deren langfristige Verlegung diskutiert.Im WELTjournal + verfolgt die preisgekronte kanadisch-iranische Dokumentarfilmerin Gelareh Darabi den Weg der Wasserkrise zuruck an die Anfange. Ineffizientes Wassermanagement in der Landwirtschaft, in die 90% des Trinkwassers flieSSen, und ein Wildwuchs an Staudammen und Brunnen haben in den letzten Jahrzehnten die Folgen des Klimawandels massiv verstarkt. 80% der Stauseen sind ausgetrocknet. Der Zayandeh Rud, der einst wasserreichste Fluss des Zentral-Iran, ist den GroSSteil des Jahres ebenfalls trocken. Der Urmia-See, einst einer der groSSten Salzseen der Erde, ist auf ein Zehntel seiner Flache geschrumpft. Die bizarre Ästhetik der ausgetrockneten Gewasser lockt unterdessen Fotografen an. Macht der Iran weiter wie bisher, wird innerhalb der nachsten Jahrzehnte knapp die Halfte seiner Provinzen unbewohnbar sein.Gestaltung: Gelareh Darabi

programme.title: Myths of the Alps / Mythen der Alpen
programme.desc: In extreme landscape areas such as the high alps, the powers of nature and people meet the people particularly hard: Eternal ice and snow masses make mountain spaces unsavable for months. Thunderstorms, storms and hails destroy the harvests. In the fraction of a second, avalanches, muries and lightning strikes not only destroy the livelihood of the people, but also also bring death to Bergdorfer.Enlang the myth of eternal ice, the myth of the magical places and the myth of sacred water, the film develops its earned structure. The camera sprints the place of mythical past and combines the most real stories that hide behind the legends and rites, with the grandiose high alpine nature and cultural landscape of Austria, Italy, Germany, France and Switzerland. A film by Manfred CorrineKo Orf/BMUKK / In extremen Landschaftsraumen wie den Hochalpen treffen die Gewalten der Natur und die Bedurfnisse der Menschen besonders hart aufeinander: Ewiges Eis und Schneemassen machen Gebirgspasse monatelang unbegehbar. Gewitter, Sturm und Hagel vernichten die Ernten. Lawinen, Muren und Blitzschlag zerstoren im Bruchteil einer Sekunde nicht nur die Existenzgrundlage der Menschen, sondern bringen manchmal auch den Tod in die Bergdorfer.Entlang dem Mythos vom ewigen Eis, dem Mythos von den magischen Orten und dem Mythos vom heiligen Wasser entwickelt der Film seine Erzahlstruktur. Die Kamera spurt die Platze mythischer Vergangenheit auf und verbindet die meist realen Geschichten, die sich hinter den Sagen und Riten verbergen, mit der grandiosen hochalpinen Natur- und Kulturlandschaft Österreichs, Italiens, Deutschlands, Frankreichs und der Schweiz.Ein Film von Manfred CorrineKo ORF/ARTE/BMUKK

programme.title: Pielach - in the garden of the Prealps / Pielach - Im Garten der Voralpen
programme.desc: The valley on the side of the Pielach has many surprising facets - you just have to know how to discover them. In the river itself, there are still considerable frames of the huchen, the legendary two meter long Danube coach, and many curious fish such as Stromer, Zingel and Goldsteinbeisser. On the banks of Bruten Gansesager, the rare kingfisher and 20 different types of dragonfly. Just as rare, even if civilization is a little close, the traditional craftsmanship, which are still being explored in the Pielach valley - are a blacksmith, broombinder or deer horn button maker. Sense for traditions lies in the essence of this front garden of the Alps: hardly where else is the traces of human colonization reach so deep into the past. Mammut hunter settled on the Pielach in the Paleolithic, Celts and Romer left their tracks. A journey with a tremendous thread detail through the gentle sensations of the Alpine foreland. A film by Kurt Mundl / Das Tal zu Seiten der Pielach besitzt viele uberraschende Facetten - man muss sie nur zu entdecken wissen. Im Fluss selbst leben noch beachtliche Bestande des Huchen, des legendaren zwei Meter langen Donaulachses, und viele kuriose Fische wie Stromer, Zingel und GoldsteinbeiSSer. An den Ufern bruten Gansesager, daruber schwirren rare Eisvogel und 20 verschiedene Libellen-Arten. Ebenso selten, wenn auch der Zivilisation ein wenig naher, sind die traditionellen Handwerksberufe, die im Pielachtal noch ausgeubt werden - seien es Schmied, Besenbinder oder Hirschhornknopfmacher. Sinn fur Traditionen liegt im Wesen dieses Vorgartens der Alpen: Kaum sonst wo reichen die Spuren menschlicher Besiedelung so tief in die Vergangenheit. Bereits in der Altsteinzeit siedelten Mammutjager an der Pielach, spater hinterlieSSen Kelten und Romer ihre Spuren. Eine Reise mit Gespur furs Detail durch die sanften Sensationen des Alpenvorlands.Ein Film von Kurt Mundl

programme.title: In a traumort / Traumorte
